data.summary: Muster Mobil GmbH wrote on 5 December 2025 that the monthly base price of your "Muster Allnet 10 GB" plan rises from €19.99 to €22.99 from 1 February 2026. You have a special right to cancel.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly base price by €3.00 from 1 February 2026. Everything else stays the same. Because the change is not only in your favour, you have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) free of charge within three months of receiving the letter. The contract then ends at the earliest when the change takes effect. You can decide whether to accept the new price or cancel; the app shows until when you can cancel. If you want to cancel, do it in writing to the provider.
